content.title: Believe - 2012 Remaster

alternatives.text: "Believe," the 2012 remaster from Cher's album "Happy New Year," is a masterful blend of electronic pop and timeless emotional resonance. Cher's voice, now digitally refined, retains its distinctive vibrato and swagger, elevating the song's universal theme of empowerment and self-sufficiency. The track's 80s-style electronic beats and catchy hooks make it a testament to Cher's enduring artistry.
